candidates.description: This vector represents personal pronouns and pronominal references across different languages.
This feature vector represents common Spanish words and root forms, particularly interrogative pronouns and indefinite terms like "que" and "como".
These tokens represent adverbs and adverbial modifiers in Romance languages, primarily indicating manner, degree, or extent.
This vector represents quotation marks and terminal punctuation marks combined at the end of sentences or clauses.
Spanish prepositions indicating spatial, temporal, or logical relations.
This vector represents traditional European male given names, particularly of French and Germanic origin.
This vector represents semantic concepts and linguistic roots related to meaning, representation, and correspondence across different languages.
This vector represents Spanish pronominal, demonstrative, and relational words used for pointing, comparison, or manner.
This vector represents concepts related to human existence, society, and culture.
This vector activates on tokens containing the Spanish letter sequence "qu" or related roots.
